note.simple: Sent through the air in the slots the mast gives your phone. The controller behind the mast checks every piece arrived and asks again if one got lost.
note.technical: MAC-hs in the NodeB sends it in the 2 ms TTIs its scheduler grants and resends with HARQ; RLC in the RNC ciphers it and resends what HARQ missed.

line: 3G HSPA user plane, H-RNTI {hrnti}, RLC SN {rlcsn}

hrnti.about: The NodeB’s short name for this phone on the shared HSDPA channel (it marks the phone’s slots on the control channel).

queue.name: Priority queue
queue.about: MAC-hs header: which of the phone’s queues in the NodeB this came from.

tsn.name: Transmission sequence no.
tsn.about: MAC-hs header: puts the 2 ms blocks back in order after HARQ resends.

rlcsn.name: RLC sequence number
rlcsn.about: Puts segments in order between phone and RNC and asks again for lost ones (ARQ).
